name: Director's Cut Dungeon Warp (QA Tester)
author: Nocturne
description: Toggleable Director's Cut test-warp utility for Shadow Hearts: Covenant. Jump directly from any loaded field save into Nahash Temple, Cannes Boat (Nahash hook), Deeper Neam Ruins, Sea of Woods, Dog Shrine, Ring Soul Quiz, or the Debug Warp Room without altering your real saves.

settings.label: Warp Destination
settings.description: Director's Cut dungeon or test room to warp into when pressing the Warp hotkey

settings.label: Warp Hotkey
settings.description: Press while standing on any field map to warp to the selected destination

settings.label: Next Destination Key
settings.description: Cycle through Director's Cut warp destinations on the fly

settings.label: Show Warp HUD Pill
settings.description: Display current map ID and selected warp target in the top-left corner
